subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: Which remaining recovery contract should be canonical for isolated cron failures after the partial fallback and stream-idle fixes: watchdog phase handling, session reset after repeated failures, or separate narrower trackers only?
rationale: The remaining failures cross cron watchdog timing, provider fallback classification, and persisted isolated-session recovery, and a reset/failover policy can change existing cron session semantics.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and finish canonical fixes
options.body: Keep #91363 open while landing or rejecting the narrower watchdog/session-recovery PRs, then require live scheduled isolated-cron proof before closure.

options.title: Split to narrower open issues
options.body: Close #91363 only after explicitly promoting #91892, #93912, and any session-reset issue as canonical owners for every remaining subpath.

options.title: Accept current partial fixes
options.body: Treat the merged stream/fallback work as sufficient and close this broad report despite recent user evidence, reopening only with a fresh minimal reproduction.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and finish canonical fixes
recommendation.body: Keep #91363 open while landing or rejecting the narrower watchdog/session-recovery PRs, then require live scheduled isolated-cron proof before closure.
